notes: Every sport+league+fulltime market family+n_way model is independently trained; no cross-league coefficients, hyperparameter fitting or calibration data.
Fixed candidates and settings; no selecting a winner on evaluation results.
All archived offers are evaluated, not the service's past stored picks or today highlights.
Quarter-start training excludes the preceding 7 calendar days; this does not prove historical settlement availability.
Multiclass Brier is sum of squared class errors, not the selected-pick binary Brier used in the short experiment.
Four-calendar-week block bootstrap, two-sided centered bootstrap diagnostics, Holm adjustment across leagues, candidates and both loss metrics.
League-level historical improvement additionally requires adequate events/weeks and positive Brier and log-loss gains in both evaluation years.
No operating artifact, database writes, service restart, merge or deployment.
